meta.title: About — HatchGrab
meta.description: HatchGrab was started by Dominic Bonini, who built Village Foodie to find out which food trucks were coming to his village. It’s a small company, and he runs it himself.

title: Hi, I’m Dominic.

story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks visit, but I never knew which one was coming, or when, without digging through Facebook.
story.villageFoodie: So I built Village Foodie, a simple way to see which trucks are coming to villages near you.
story.hatchgrab: The more trucks I looked at, the more I thought they deserved better tools: something built for a business that’s somewhere different every day, not a restaurant with a fixed address. That’s why I started HatchGrab.
story.small: It’s a small company and I run it myself. If you get in touch, you’ll hear back from me, not a support queue.
